data.name: Defentrix
data.detailed_description:
The modern graphics of Defentrix!

Defentrix – New Graphics Update

We’ve added a new graphics system to Defentrix. Now you can decide yourself how sharp the game should look.

New Setting: enter a k value

There is now a text field in the game.
You can simply type a number with k to set the internal rendering resolution.

Important:
The k must be lowercase.

Examples:

  • 0.4k → very low resolution (retro / Atari-like graphics)

  • 1k → very high performance

  • 4k → high graphics quality

  • 8k → extremely sharp graphics

  • 16k → maximum resolution

You can also enter other values such as 2k, 5k, 10k, or 12k.
The game will automatically adjust the internal rendering resolution.

Performance depends on your PC

The higher the number, the better the graphics. However, higher values also require more performance from your PC.

Mid-range PC

  • 4k usually runs very well

  • 8k often runs stable

Lower-end PCs

  • 4k is recommended

  • 16k works technically, but with low FPS

High-end PCs

  • 8k runs very smoothly

  • 16k can run without problems

Just try different values

You can change the k value anytime and see what your PC can handle.

  • more FPS → lower number

  • better graphics → higher number

Update available now

The new graphics system has already been released and is now included in Defentrix.

Try different k values and find the best balance between performance and graphics for your system.


About the Game

Defentrix

Defentrix is a ruthless tower defense game built for players who love strategy, precision, and tactical gameplay.
There’s no luck or randomness — only your mind, your defense strategy, and your ability to analyze the battlefield under pressure.

Construct your defensive towers, upgrade their abilities, and strengthen your base defense to survive the escalating waves.
Each round challenges you to refine your tower placement, balance resource management, and react to dynamic enemy movement.
Defentrix rewards strategic mastery, concentration, and calculated precision, delivering an intense tower defense experience where every second counts.

If you enjoy strategy games that value skill, timing, and perfect control, Defentrix is your arena for tactical dominance — a pure test of focus and planning.
Across 45 challenging levels, you’ll face a continuous rise in speed, enemy mass, and pressure, testing your reaction time, focus, and strategic thinking. Every stage demands real-time decisions, where smart placement and quick adaptation decide your success.

⚙️ Defentrix – Standard Edition

Your entry into the core experience of Defentrix – a classic tower defense strategy game focused on balance, structure, and challenge.

🧱 Varied levels with increasing complexity, designed to test your strategic adaptation and defensive coordination
🔧 Towers with unique abilities, upgrade paths, and powerful defense mechanics that reward smart planning
🧠 Dynamic enemy formations that require constant analysis and tactical adjustments each wave
🎯 Perfect for players who enjoy strategic control, precision timing, and the satisfaction of mastering tower placement

Every level in the Standard Edition teaches you the foundation of tower defense gameplay — understanding enemy patterns, improving reaction strategy, and learning to manage your resources efficiently.

🔥 Defentrix – Magma Edition

The Magma Edition is an enhanced version built for experienced players seeking greater difficulty and visual immersion. It amplifies every aspect of the Defentrix tower defense experience, demanding sharper focus and stronger tactics.

💥 New glowing arenas with immersive visual effects, pushing the limits of atmosphere and intensity
⚔️ Tougher enemies that move faster and strike harder, challenging your reaction speed and defensive precision
🚀 More intense endgame waves requiring perfect tower coordination and real-time adaptation under heavy pressure
🌋 Exclusive levels crafted for tactical players, where strategy, timing, and base defense planning decide the outcome

The Magma Edition of Defentrix offers a full hardcore tower defense challenge — built for those who crave difficulty, control, and total strategic immersion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
